description: Elections Commission - Elected to the member of the Boralesgamuwa Urban Council
categorisation: The gazette content is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically publishing the names of members returned to local authorities. This falls squarely under the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes "Election results and declarations." The content is focused on the electoral process and its outcomes, not on government personnel changes (Types 1-3) or any other specialized administrative matter.
